title: 好一个美得另类的女子此邂逅非彼邂逅
content_zh:
好一个美得另类的女子！
一条小/江，隔着两条街道，对立着一排又一排的房子与柳树，隔二十米之遥便搭建着一座石拱桥，石拱桥两头的柳树枝，都已生长得垂吊在了桥头上。
一抹倩影自桥那头，露了出来，那是凤府的凤蝶舞。
凤府是帝/都富甲之家的千金，家财万贯，而凤蝶舞，便是令帝/都千万家姑娘儿羡慕妒，忌，恨的富家千金，闻其名，却难相遇。
然，今日天是否下过红雨？
凤蝶舞褪去铅华，一件白色素衣裹身，素衣线条简约，与她平日里所穿的华丽衣袍一比，简直可以用麻雀与凤凰所比较。原本金钗银簪镶于发中，此刻，一头青丝垂直于身后，胸前垂着两缕，在后脑勺，挽了个蝴蝶鬓，用一条白色的轻纱缠着。原本套着的千金玉镯，在纤细无骨的手腕，已然找不到踪影。
若认识她的人，见她这副模样，定问她是否吃错药了，放着绫罗绸缎不穿，金银珠宝不戴，偏偏披那粗布麻衣。
虽然穿上朴素的衣服，看似一位良家女儿一样，但凤蝶舞行走端庄，举止优雅，眉梢含涩，沉静娇柔的气质，本就出自大家闺秀身上，纵然她改变了穿着，也无法改变她文弱书香的恬静气质，仍旧给人沉静的大小姐之美，之态，之韵。
凤蝶舞双手交叠在左腰间，随时保持着优雅之姿，只是舒展的眉梢，以及唇角深深的弧度，透露了她心中有着满满的喜悦。
她特意打扮成这样，是为了去做某件事，这件事，更像是去会心上人！
“别跑——”桥头这边，唐琳奋力追赶那拿走老壮汉钱袋的地痞，仅仅差那么几步就把地痞给追上来了。
那地痞已跑得满头大汗，汗水正淋漓挥洒，他难以料想会有一个女人能追得上自己，他可是出了名的快脚啊，想不到今天却栽在了一个女人的身上。
地痞不甘心，跑上旁边的石拱桥，由于没看路，把迎面而来，身子柔弱的凤蝶舞给撞倒了。
凤蝶舞“呀”的轻吟了一声，疼痛来袭。
地痞不顾被自己撞倒于桥上的凤蝶舞，撒娇就跑。
唐琳跑上来，睨了正在忍痛的凤蝶舞一眼，想紧接着向那地痞追去，但追了两步便退了回来，伸手下去，把凤蝶舞给扶起来，“小姐，你无碍吧？”
凤蝶舞摇摇头，“我没事。”声音轻柔婉约，却盖不住她痛苦的神色，一双黛眉锁紧。她的左手，正捂住右手的手臂。
唐琳看了凤蝶舞手臂一眼，这才发现凤蝶舞手臂的袖子被擦破了，石桥上的细小沙子，还擦破了凤蝶舞的肌肤。
唐琳赶紧摸摸口袋，幸亏拿有创可贴出来，她撕了一块，示意凤蝶舞，“小姐，把手放开，我帮你贴上！”
凤蝶舞把手拿开，看着唐琳把创可贴贴在她手臂上的伤口处，贴完后，阵阵凉意袭击她的神经，觉得很不可思议，望向唐琳的脸，正想对唐琳说点什么时，唐琳的奇装异服，以及这张面容俱佳的脸，令她怔住。

好一个美得另类的女子！
content_en:
What an unusually beautiful woman!
There is a small river, separated by two streets, facing rows and rows of houses and willow trees. A stone arch bridge is built twenty meters away. The willow branches at both ends of the stone arch bridge have grown to hang on the bridge head.
A beautiful figure emerged from the other side of the bridge. It was the dancing butterfly of Feng Mansion.
Fengfu is the daughter of a wealthy family in the imperial capital, with a huge fortune, and Feng Diewu is the daughter of a wealthy family who is envied, jealous, and hated by thousands of girls in the imperial capital. After hearing her name, it is difficult to meet her.
However, did it rain red today?
The phoenix dance faded away, and she was wrapped in a white plain dress with simple lines. Compared with the gorgeous robes she usually wore, she could be compared to a sparrow and a phoenix. Originally, gold hairpins and silver hairpins were embedded in her hair. At this moment, a black hair is vertically hanging behind her back, with two strands hanging on her chest. On the back of her head, she has a butterfly sideburn, wrapped with a piece of white gauze. The thousand-gold jade bracelet that was originally worn on her slender, boneless wrist could no longer be found.
If someone who knew her saw her like this, they would definitely ask her if she had taken the wrong medicine. She didn't wear silk and satin, or gold, silver, or jewelry, but just wore the coarse linen clothes.
Although she wears simple clothes and looks like a daughter of a good family, Fengdiewu walks dignifiedly, behaves elegantly, has a frown on her eyebrows, and has a quiet and delicate temperament. She originally came from a lady. Even if she changes her clothes, she cannot change her quiet temperament of being frail and scholarly. She still gives people the beauty, attitude and charm of a quiet young lady.
Fengdiewu folded her hands on her left waist, maintaining an elegant posture at all times. However, her stretched eyebrows and the deep curvature of her lips revealed the full joy in her heart.
She dressed up like this specially to do something. This thing was more like going to meet her sweetheart!
"Don't run -" Over at the bridge, Tang Lin struggled to catch up with the gangster who had taken away the old man's money bag. She was just a few steps away from catching up with him.
The ruffian was already running and sweating profusely. He could not have imagined that a woman would be able to catch up with him. He was famous for his quick feet, but he did not expect that he would fall on a woman today.
Unwilling to give in, the ruffian ran onto the stone arch bridge next to him. Because he didn't look at the road, he knocked down the frail Phoenix Butterfly Wu who was coming towards him.
Swallowtail Wu groaned softly, pain came over her.
The gangster ignored Fengdiewu who was knocked down by him on the bridge, and ran away like a baby.
Tang Lin ran up and glanced at Fengdiewu who was enduring the pain. She wanted to chase after the ruffian, but after two steps, she stepped back. She reached down and helped Fengdiewu up, "Miss, are you okay?"
Fengdiewu shook her head, "I'm fine." Her voice was soft and graceful, but it couldn't cover up her painful look, and her eyebrows were furrowed. Her left hand was covering her right arm.
Tang Lin glanced at Fengdie Wu's arm, and then she realized that the sleeve of Feng Diewu's arm was scratched, and the fine sand on the stone bridge also scratched Fengdie Wu's skin.
Tang Lin quickly touched her pocket, and luckily she brought out a band-aid. She tore off a piece and signaled to Fengdie Wu, "Miss, let go of your hand and I'll put it on for you!"
Fengdie Wu took her hand away and watched Tang Lin put the band-aid on the wound on her arm. After applying it, a chill hit her nerves. She felt it was incredible. She looked at Tang Lin's face. When she was about to say something to Tang Lin, she was stunned by Tang Lin's strange clothes and this beautiful face.
What an unusually beautiful woman!
